lede: A scattered Tuesday, September 22: no single story crossed the feeds, so the day is best read one number at a time. The largest was on Steam, where Counter-Strike 2 held 1,218,401 players at once. On Wikipedia, Lizzie Borden drew just over a million views, lifted by a dramatized retelling of her case that also ranked among the day's most-read articles. On Hacker News, Xiaomi's MiMo v2.6 model release led the conversation.

throughlines.title: Lizzie Borden
throughlines.gist: The day's most-read Wikipedia article at just over a million views, riding renewed interest in a dramatized retelling of the 1892 case.

throughlines.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
throughlines.gist: A TypeScript framework for building agentic apps that topped GitHub trending with 607 new stars today, another marker of how much builder attention is flowing to agent tooling.

throughlines.title: MiMo v2.6
throughlines.gist: Xiaomi's MiMo v2.6 model release led Hacker News with 705 points and 330 comments, a sign of steady appetite for new open model launches.
